name: English Football League Charts & Analysis App

mentions.name: English Football League Charts & Analysis App
mentions.description: This app displays charts, analysis, and data on English football league games. It includes multiple chart types such as violin plots, heatmaps, and line charts, interactive charts, and JavaScript widgets that interact with Bokeh charts. The app is at the deployment stage and doubles as an exercise in using code gen AI (Cursor) for data science projects and rapid deployment.
